upstream_fix_review.details: Guards the copy and the free with multlocptr != NULL, which covers both the sender case (size 0) and the 'ratio not met' return 1 (vertlocnbr already set, array never created). upstream_fix_review.compared_with_ours: Ours (7.0.17 0010) tested multlocptr in the outer condition, so it also skipped the debug size check; his is the smaller change and is enough. Ours is dropped (after his commit it would only add a redundant test).

review_accuracy: accurate on the UB; its fix 'skip when vertlocnbr == 0' leaves the crash on the ratio-not-met path (vertlocnbr > 0, no array)
first_pass_critique: Right, including the o != 0 observation and the preferred guard on the pointer; its claim that the o=1 case 'also reaches the memCpy' was shown on the size-0 path only (coarnbr=1000); the ratio-not-met path is the crash.

our_title: dgraphCoarsen() initialises matching data after a failed coarsening init
ran: Pristine 7.0.18: `cd /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-playground/925301e5-494b-5a33-b598-8eaa63dd5c1d/scratchpad/work18/G21-dgraph-band-coarsen/repro/common; FI_TIMEOUT=20 ./scan.sh <lib> bin_<build>/g21fi 2 1 3 5 -- coarsen ring 0 8 0` -> nth=3,4 exit=139 :: dgraphCoarsenInit: out of memory (3)/(4); dgraph_match.c:93:31: runtime error: member access within misaligned address 0xfefefefefefefefe; signal 11. Patched (P6): nth=3,4,5 coarsen rc=2 on both ranks. Output: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-playground/925301e5-494b-5a33-b598-8eaa63dd5c1d/scratchpad/work18/G21-dgraph-band-coarsen/repro/fi_matrix_7018.txt
severity_note: crash (not a hang) of the failing process on any of the four initial allocations; the first pass's rating
evidence:
dgraph_coarsen.c:1359-1360: `cheklocval  = dgraphCoarsenInit (&matedat.c, finegrafptr, coargrafptr);
  cheklocval |= dgraphMatchInit   (&matedat, 0.5F);`
review_accuracy: (first-pass finding) accurate; incomplete: it did not see that dgraphMatchExit() then frees an uninitialised procvgbtab and that dgraphCoarsenExit() runs twice on what dgraphCoarsenInit() already freed (coarprvptr, multloctmp): a double free on the 'out of memory (2)..(4)' paths even with its fix
first_pass_critique: Its preferred fix ('call MatchInit only if cheklocval == 0') is half of the fix; its tradeoff note 'error branch must not call dgraphMatchExit on an uninitialised matedat' is right but it left the double dgraphCoarsenExit() unmentioned. Option A removes the self-cleanup from dgraphCoarsenInit() (its header comment now says that cleanup is the caller's, after the agreement) and exits the matching data only when it was initialised.

extra_instances.location: src/libscotch/dgraph_coarsen.c:1363-1366 (MPI_Allreduce failure returns without any cleanup)

fix_options.label: A: init matching data only on success; one cleanup in dgraphCoarsen() after the agreement
fix_options.summary: `if (cheklocval == 0) cheklocval = dgraphMatchInit (...)`; dgraphCoarsenInit() no longer calls dgraphCoarsenExit() itself; on error, dgraphMatchExit() only if the matching data exists, then dgraphCoarsenExit(); the Allreduce failure falls into the same cleanup
fix_options.tested: injection nth=3..6 (all four Init allocations and the MatchInit one): rc=2 on all ranks; 32-bit ASan+UBSan and 64-bit Gnum trees: all 15 CHECKPTSCOTCH targets (np=3) rc=0, the dgraph test programs and dgpart/dgord/dgtst at np 1, 2, 4 rc=0, `make ptcheck` rc=0, zero sanitizer reports (chk_32/chk_64_summary.txt); -DSCOTCH_DEBUG_ALL tree: dgraph targets rc=0 (chk_dbg_summary.txt); 0 build warnings in all trees
fix_options.tradeoffs: none
fix_options.maintainer_fit: the 'TRICK: negative value on error' agreement already exists; he routes cleanup through one place after the agreement in 3c9b3ab and in G19's dgraphGhst2()

fix_options.label: B: make dgraphMatchInit()/Exit() tolerate a failed coarsening init
fix_options.summary: NULL-init coargsttax and set the graph pointers at the top of dgraphCoarsenInit(); bail out of dgraphMatchInit() early; guard dgraphMatchExit()
fix_options.tested: untested: sketch
fix_options.tradeoffs: hides the ordering in the callee, touches three files, keeps the double dgraphCoarsenExit()
fix_options.maintainer_fit: no precedent for defensive Init routines in the dgraph module
